title: Grodno-93 smother Minsk in Game 5 fight to seize ninth crown
description: There was nothing pretty about the way Grodno-93 ended their wait, and they would not have cared. In a grinding, low-scoring decider, Grodno-93 strangled Minsk 60-51 to win game 5 of the Belarusian Premier League finals and take the best-of-five series 3-2, claiming a ninth national championship at the expense of the country's most decorated club. Grodno-93 won the title where finals are usually decided on defense. They smothered Minsk into a dismal shooting night: 28.1 percent from the field overall and a near-unwatchable 1-of-19 from three-point range, just 5.3 percent. Minsk actually controlled the glass, out-rebounding Grodno-93 50-32, but never came close to converting that edge with the ball clanging off the rim all evening.
imageCaption: Grodno-93 smother Minsk in Game 5 fight to seize ninth crown (Photo: IG)

title: Stade Malien successfully start championship series
description: Stade Malien - CRB Tombouctou 68-63 Stade Malien successfully started championship series beating CRB Tombouctou. They dominated the majority of the game to seal a 68-63 win. Namory Keita stepped up with 14 points and 8 rebounds. Game 2 is scheduled for May 29th.
imageCaption: Grodno win 24/25 Premier League title (Photo: belarus.basketball)

title: Minsk capture Premier League title
description: Grodno - Minsk 81-90 Minsk captured Premier League title. They outscored Grodno on the road in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the trophy. Grodno trailed by 15 points after 3 quarters before a 27-21 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 81-90 at the end of the game. Minsk looked well-organized offensively handing out 29 assists. 24 personal fouls committed by Grodno helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of forward Jovan Sljivancanin (196-1999, college: Carroll, MT) who helped to win the game recording 17 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists. The former international center Vadzim Stubeda (206-2000, agency: Tolakh Tsimur) contributed with 18 points and 8 rebounds for the winners. imageCaption: Minsk capture Premier League title (Photo: BC Minsk)

title: BC Minsk claim 15th Premier League title
description: Grodno-93 - BC Minsk 63-105 BC Minsk conquered the Premier League title. They overcame Grodno-93 in Game 3 of the championship series to complete the sweep. Uladzislau Blizniuk (181-PG-1999) came up with 23 points to lead the champions. BC Minsk unloaded 34 points in the first period to take a 14-point lead. BC Minsk followed with a 25-11 run in the second frame to take a 59-31 halftime lead. BC Minsk kept Grodno-93 at bay throughout the second half and raced to the triumph. Zach Smith (203-F-1996, college: Texas Tech) posted 18 points and 12 rebounds for the champions. Nikola Djuric (203-F/C-1991) answered with 15 points for Grodno-93.
imageCaption: BC Minsk claim 15th Premier League title (Photo: BC Minsk)

title: Tsmoki-Minsk claim Premier League title
description: Tsmoki-Minsk have been crowned Premier League champions. They overcame Borisfen 81-75 in Game 3 of the Finals to complete the sweep. The win marked the 14th straight Premier League trophy. Uladzislau Blizniuk (181-PG-1999, agency: BIG) finished with 24 points to pace the champions. Borisfen eked out a 22-18 lead ten minutes into the game. Tsmoki-Minsk bounced back in the second period to snatch a 42-41 halftime lead. The Minsk team maintained the lead throughout the third term. Tsmoki-Minsk arrived at the final break up by 3 points 62-59. The hosts held Borisfen to just 16 points in the fourth period and rallied to the triumph at the end. Aliaksei Trostinetskiy (200-F-1986) posted 16 points in the victory. Ilya Sharipov (198-SF-1991) and Vladislav Mikhailik (1995) netted 19 points each for Borisfen.
imageCaption: Tsmoki-Minsk claim Premier League title (Photo: belarus.basketball)

title: Tsmoki-Minsk earn Premier League title
description: Borisfen - Tsmoki-Minsk 52-85 Tsmoki-Minsk earned their 13th Premier League title. They beat Borisfen for the third straight win in the Finals and conquered the trophy. Kris Clyburn (198-G-96, college: UNLV) posted 20 points and 9 rebounds to lead the champions. Tsmoki-MInsk dominated from start to finish. The visitors unleashed 29 points in the first period to take a 13-point lead. Tsmoki-Minsk stayed in charge throughout the second quarter. They established a 48-31 halftime lead. Tsmoki-Minsk held the hosts to just 5 points in the third term and cleared off for good. Derek Cooke Jr. (206-F-91, college: Wyoming) accounted for 13 points for the winners. Dupree McBrayer (195-G-96, college: Minnesota) responded with 14 points for Borisfen.
imageCaption: Tsmoki-Minsk earn Premier League title (Photo: Twitter)
